svg.title: The Swiss cheese model, labelled with the four layers of a harness
svg.desc: Four slices in a row. An agent action enters at the left; slice 1 is instructions, slice 2 workflows and tools, slice 3 hooks, scripts and linters, slice 4 validation and tests. Where holes line up, a bad change lands.
svg.text: check at the moment of action
tests and CI before a change lands
